description: Demolition of the existing buildings and the phased re-development of the site incorporating a basement car/cycle park, the erection of seven buildings comprised of lower ground floor, ground and ranging between six and thirteen upper storeys and landscaped gardens for a mixed use scheme comprised of a replacement gateway education facility, nursery (Class E(f)) and the provision of residential units including a mix of studios, 1, 2, 3 and 4 bedroom units.
